name: lumen-site
description: LUMEN: live seats and noise for every floor of TMU's Student Learning Centre. Decide before you ride.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
